before.meaningZh: 尺寸；量度器；量度標準；測量；度量
before.meaningEn: (n.) the process of finding a size or amount, or the numerical result of that process. (Related word measure) to find the size, length, or amount of something; as a noun, an action taken to achieve a result.
before.usagePattern: take measurements of N; measurement of N; accurate measurements
before.sourceNote: 高中英文參考詞彙表（111學年度起適用，大考中心）；由 measure(ment) 拆分，沿用原列合併釋義，待人工拆義。
before.usagePatternZh: 測量……的尺寸；對……的測量；精確的測量結果

after.meaningZh: （measurement）尺寸；測量；度量；（另詞 measure 的名詞義）量度器；量度標準
after.meaningEn: (n.) the process of finding a size or amount, or the numerical result of that process. (Related word measure) to find the size, length, or amount of something; as a noun, an action taken to achieve a result.
after.usagePattern: take measurements of N; measurement of N; accurate measurements
after.sourceNote: 高中英文參考詞彙表（111學年度起適用，大考中心）；由 measure(ment) 拆分，沿用原列合併釋義，待人工拆義。
after.usagePatternZh: 測量……的尺寸；對……的測量；精確的測量結果

changes.reason: Make the same verified measurement/measure distinction visible in the Chinese hero field. The instrument/standard senses belong to the separately identified noun measure; retain those real senses with an explicit headword label, rather than treating them as measurement or deleting them.
